about: Answers of src/services/cleanupEngine.js (runCleanupRules) with every vault copy verified and no external mirror. tests/unit/cleanupRuleParity.test.js ran them against that JS; src-core/src/cleanup_rules.rs must select the same deletes.

cases.name: deletes exactly the messages past the threshold
a wider threshold deletes nothing
one month is thirty days
three months is ninety days
an age given as a numeric string is read as that number
archive-then-delete archives the stale uids of the folder first
Sent reaches the Sent-role folder
all walks every selectable folder except Drafts, in list order
only the Trash-role folder is emptied permanently
Gmail: Trash resolves to the declared Trash, not a label called Trash
Gmail: a label called Trash is moved, not emptied, when a Trash is declared
no declared Trash: the folder named Trash is the one emptied
no declared Junk: the folder named Junk is found by its name
a rule folder that is a literal path matches that path
a folder the account does not have cleans nothing
an account whose folder list was never cached is skipped
the plain mailbox list is used when there is no last known good one
an old array-shaped mailbox cache is a mailbox list
the last known good list wins over the current one
an empty last known good list is an empty list
a noselect folder and a Drafts folder without a role are left out of all
all reaches every visible account
a named account reaches only that account
a rule for the other account leaves this one alone
a hidden account is not cleaned
rules run in order and each one deletes what it matched
a disabled rule next to an enabled one does nothing
header dates: RFC 2822 with a comment, unreadable, missing, and exactly at the cutoff
refuses no age at all
refuses an age that is not a number
refuses an age of zero
refuses a negative age
refuses an unknown unit
refuses an age below the seven-day floor
refuses six days
refuses the old action spelling
refuses an action nobody recognises
refuses a protected folder
seven days is the floor and runs
no premium: nothing runs
no subscription: nothing runs
clientAccessGranted false wins over premiumAccess
clientAccessGranted true runs
premiumAccess false wins over an active status
trialing runs
past_due runs
canceled with time left runs
canceled and over does not run
